description: The trail climbs to an elevation of +/- 2176m , off of Tenquille/Owl Lakes Trail System starting from an elevation of +/- 1626 m . The trail is below Mount Barbour elevation 2290 m . This trail will take you to the alpine. No biking, horseback riding or dogs are allowed within the Tenquille Lake Recreation Site boundary.
directions: Mount Barbour Trail is accessed from the Tenquille Lake Recreation site. Access to the trail is on the East side of Tenquille Lake. For more information on accessing Tenquille Lake Recreation site, please click here!
title: Mount Barbour Trail
